variants.heading: Mobile tab variants
variants.empty_help: Drag items here to add them to this variant.
variants.help: Variants are checked from top to bottom. Users will see the first enabled variant they have permission to view. Put more specific roles first, for example: #1 administrators, #2 moderators, #3 members, #4 everyone. Leave a variant empty to hide the tab entirely for the selected groups.
